tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// rigs lnga'i bum sgrub bzhugs so// oṃ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi sdong pos kha brgyan pa/ byang chub sems kyi rdo rjes mtshan pa/ thugs rje rgyun gyi gzungs thag dang ldan pa/ phyi bum pa'i dbyibs la nang gzhal yas khang yangs shing rgya che bar bsgom/ bum pa'i chu de a las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bsams pa'i steng du/ dbus su seng ge brgyad kyi khri/ shar du glang po che'i khri/ lhor rta mchog gi khri/ nub tu rma bya'i khri/ byang du shang shang gi khri/ de lnga'i steng du so sor padma nyi zla'i steng du oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ zhes pa lnga las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu bsnams pa/ shar du rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog mthing ga rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po rin po che dang dril bu bsnams pa/ nub tu snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po padma dang dril bu bsnams pa/ byang du don yod grub pa ljang gu rgya gram dang dril bu bsnams pa/ de dag thams cad dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ zhing khams lnga la sogs pa nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drang*/ badzra sa ma ya dzaḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ badzra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod cing*/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas bum nang gi lha'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/

lha'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs rnams ā li dang kā li dang rten 'brel snying po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ bum nang gi lhar bstim/ lha lnga'i sku'i cha las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa babs/ bum chu dang dbyer med par bsams la bzlas pa bya/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// longs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ba las bum chu nus ldan du gyur// sarba dā maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
